name: Metadata Panel
description: A compact key-value panel for operational metadata and object facts.

accessibility.semantics: Use a description list for key-value metadata whenever possible.
accessibility.keyboard: No keyboard behavior required unless interactive content is slotted.
accessibility.focus: Inherits global focus styles for slotted links or controls.
notes: Do not rely on color alone for status.
Use clear row labels and values.

responsive.strategy: Rows wrap intrinsically and keep labels readable on narrow screens.

examples.name: Standalone
examples.notes: Consumer-authored reference, no automatic prop binding. Prefix IDs before repeating.

binding.html: textContent or accessible name appropriate to the element
authored child markup in canonical example; arrays are consumer data, never automatically bound

items.contract: Authored data structure: label is displayed text; content is escaped text or trusted authored slot markup. Optional href is a consumer-owned safe navigation URL. No automatic renderer.

default.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

compact.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

sidecar.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

guidance.use: Present labeled key/value rows in a definition list.
guidance.avoid: A JSON parser or automatically generated inspector.

rows.content: Trusted authored semantic HTML; preserve child structure in example.html. Text data must be escaped.
